name: Wand of Fortune ~Mirai e no Prologue~
original_name: ワンド オブ フォーチュン ～未来へのプロローグ～
source:
Wand of Fortune -Mirai e no Prologue- is a fan disc of Wand of Fortune. The disc features new characters and new episodes. Also, you can enjoy your school life more deeply.

[From Himeya Shop]
translation:
《命運之杖～通向未來的序言～》是《命運之杖》的粉絲光碟，其中包含新角色和新篇章，也能讓玩家更深入地體驗校園生活。

[摘自Himeya Shop]
